title: Nervous system: male anatomy
description: The male figure with every nerve pathway highlighted — same wiring as the female page, shown on male proportions for side-by-side study.

questions.question: Is the male nervous system different from the female nervous system?
questions.answer: The main brain, spinal cord and peripheral nerve plan is shared. Pelvic organ targets and some local nerve relationships differ with reproductive anatomy.

questions.question: Which nerves supply the male pelvis?
questions.answer: Autonomic pelvic plexuses reach pelvic organs, while somatic branches including the pudendal nerve supply much of the perineum. Exact pathways are covered in regional chapters.

questions.question: What does the brain do in the male nervous system?
questions.answer: Cerebrum, cerebellum and brainstem inside the cranial vault. Function: Integration, consciousness, motor planning and autonomic control.

questions.question: Where is the cervical plexus on the male nerve map?
questions.answer: Nerve network in the posterior triangle of the neck. Function: Neck muscles and skin; phrenic nerve to diaphragm.

questions.question: What do the intercostal nerves do in the male body?
questions.answer: Function: Chest-wall muscles and segmental skin band. Ventral rami running in subcostal grooves.
